title: Look up and iterate over course entries
description: You associate course codes with instructor names and print those associations.

steps.description: You create courses and assign instructor strings under course-code keys. Each assignment adds an association to the dictionary.
You retrieve the instructor stored under CS170 and insert it into the printed sentence.

steps.question: What does items supply to key and value on each loop pass?
steps.answer: It supplies a course-code key and its associated instructor value. The print formats both into the sentence.

steps.description: You print every stored association after the earlier individual lookup. The recording therefore shows the CS170 sentence again during the loop.
